person.name: Jeevan Gowda Kumaraswamy
person.bio: Developer specializing in polyglot backends, microservices, and applied cryptographic systems.

projects.name: Campus Events Navigator
projects.what_is_this: A polyglot microservices platform for tracking and discovering campus events.
projects.why_this_choice: Built to explore Kubernetes orchestration, Python FastAPI, and Spring Boot service integration.
projects.what_breaks: High latency during initial cold starts when scaling down container pods under low resources.
projects.what_did_i_learn: Managing inter-service communication via NGINX Ingress and containerized state management using Redis.

not_yet.why: Prioritized web microservices and cryptographic backend architectures over low-level graphics rendering.
Focused on application-level container orchestration in local homelabs rather than enterprise multi-region cloud ops.
Focused on backend REST API development and browser-based frontends rather than mobile platforms.
